title: Scream! Halloween Special 2026 #1
desc: Doppelgangers and horrifying transformations lurk in the shadows of the Scream! 2026 Halloween Special, as the lines between reality and nightmare blur across five twisted tales - ranging from vampire conspiracies to an AI software update from hell, to body-altering experimental tech, to a mutating archeological find... Following Scream!'s 40th anniversary and the success of the Eisner-nominated Scream! The Specials 1985-2024, the anthology comic is back with all-new episodes of The Dracula File and The Thirteenth Floor, and brand new one-shots to keep you up at night all through Halloween season... and beyond!
